scripts.demos:all: npm run demos:generate && npm run demos:validate
scripts.docs:all: npm run demos:generate && npm run demos:validate && npm run snack:exports && npm run llms:generate
scripts.site:build: npm run ui:build && npm run docs:all && npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web
scripts.site:build-with-demos: npm run ui:build && npm run docs:all && npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web-with-demos
scripts.docs:baseline: npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.docs:visual: npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --workers=2
scripts.docs:visual:gallery: npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/docs/tests/visual-gallery.spec.ts --workers=2
scripts.docs:visual:gallery:apps: npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web-with-demos && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/docs/tests/visual-gallery.spec.ts --workers=2
scripts.docs:visual:charts-mobile: npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/docs/tests/chart-touch-consistency.spec.ts apps/docs/tests/visual-gallery.spec.ts --grep "chart values on phone touch|charts in phone-sized columns" --workers=2
scripts.docs:visual:update: npm --prefix apps/docs run build-web && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --workers=2 --update-snapshots
scripts.verify:packages: npm run ui:exports:check && npm run icons:check -w packages/ui && npm run skills:check && npm run ui:typecheck && npm run ui:lint && npm run ui:test && npm run ui:test:web && npm run typecheck -w packages/charts && npm run charts:lint && npm run charts:test && npm run charts:test:web && npm run packages:typecheck && npm run packages:lint && npm run packages:test && npm run packages:test:web
scripts.release:check: npm run verify:packages && npm run verify:packages:build && tsx scripts/publish-release.ts --dry-run --skip-build
scripts.release: npm run verify:packages && npm run verify:packages:build && tsx scripts/publish-release.ts --skip-build
scripts.packages:build: npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/ui-snack -w packages/charts -w packages/dates -w packages/code -w packages/media -w packages/carousel -w packages/spotlight -w packages/brands -w packages/qrcode -w packages/emoji-picker -w packages/create-plocks
scripts.packages:typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/ui-snack -w packages/dates -w packages/code -w packages/media -w packages/carousel -w packages/spotlight -w packages/brands -w packages/qrcode -w packages/emoji-picker -w packages/create-plocks
scripts.packages:lint: npm run lint -w packages/dates -w packages/code -w packages/media -w packages/carousel -w packages/spotlight -w packages/brands -w packages/qrcode -w packages/emoji-picker
scripts.packages:test: npm run test -w packages/dates -w packages/code -w packages/media -w packages/carousel -w packages/spotlight -w packages/brands -w packages/qrcode -w packages/emoji-picker -w packages/create-plocks
scripts.packages:test:web: npm run test:web -w packages/dates -w packages/code -w packages/media -w packages/carousel -w packages/spotlight -w packages/brands -w packages/qrcode -w packages/emoji-picker
